environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in production VPC (acme-prod-reporting-cluster). The LaunchDarkly flag 'report-dynamic-filter-v2' is currently enabled for all users (targeting rule: percentage rollout 100%) as part of a gradual migration that was completed but the flag was never cleaned up. Container runs with task role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/reporting-task-role. ALB forwards all /api/v2/* traffic directly to target group on port 8080.
